sentences.text: The petitioner is aggrieved by the order contained in Letter No. 2281 dated 27.08.2024 issued by the Executive Patna High Court CWJC No.15720 of 2024(2) dt.08-10-2024 Engineer, Irrigation Division, Biharsharif

by which 141.03 acres of land situated at Mauza-Motnaje, Than No. 430, Circle Nardiganj and 310.34 acres of land situated at Mauza Madhuban, Than No. 429, Circle-Nardiganj has been directed to to be acquired under the provision of Section 40 of the Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013 under Gangajal Apurti Yojana Phase-2 Part-1.

entities.text: Right to Fair Compensation and Transparency in Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Resettlement Act, 2013
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: 3. Learned Advocate for the petitioners contended that the entire acquisition proceeding is wholly without jurisdiction as no notice has ever been given to the petitioners whose raiyati lands are going to be acquired.
Various other points have been taken in order to challenge the impugned letter.

4. Let a counter affidavit be filed on behalf of respondent nos. 7 to 9, preferably within a period of four weeks.
5.
Re -notify this case on 18.11.2024.
6. Any order/development passed during the interregnum period shall be subject to the final outcome of the writ petition.

(Harish Kumar, J) Anjani/-
